primary_cohort: common Yahoo/Vietcap positive-volume origin AND target date pairs
secondary_cohort: all eligible Vietcap origins for research Ridge and reference baselines
price_metrics: all predictions anchored to SAME Vietcap Close at origin; adjusted VND, not execution prices
forecast_horizon: one next positive-volume observation with observed causal OHLCV context; not autonomous multi-step year forecast
evaluation_role: newly inspected temporal 2026 retrospective holdout; weights trained/selected before opening it in this workflow, but forecasts were NOT issued live before events
limitations: Current adjusted source history is not independently point-in-time certified; 2026 becomes inspected after this run. Different training cutoffs/sources confound cross-family comparisons.
